QNA:

Q: Why is Emily's & Haley's House decorated for Fall at the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies?
A: This is Intentional, I thought it would be a good idea for 1 House to decorate early for Fall!

Q: Does this mod work with recolors?
A: Yes!

Q: Will the Stardew Valley Fair get any decor in the future?
A: I have no plans for it, but if you have suggestions, feel free to comment them!
